name: Sakurai Kaoru
source: Mother to Kanna and Emi. She spoiled the younger Emi, while keeping an eye on Kanna. After Emi’s diagnosis, she vowed to save her.
translation: Mother to Kanna and Emi. She spoiled the younger Emi, while keeping an eye on Kanna. After Emi’s diagnosis, she vowed to save her.
